note: Real estate prints the customer's business facts directly in the Instructions (DECISIONS 88, option B). These are the only variables a real-estate Instructions set may use. Any other {{var.*}} is an error; so is an unresolved slot such as <business name>. This list replaces docs/shared/variables.json for real estate. booking_tool, send_link, calls_recorded and referral_program are intake flags, not variables: the skill writes the Instructions for the chosen state and names a tool only when it is on. 'status: unconfirmed' means the platform has not confirmed the variable exists.

variables.name: now_local
variables.description: Today's date and time for the call, with the dates of the coming days. Every date the agent says is read off this list.

variables.name: lead_name
variables.description: Outbound calls: the name of the lead being called. Used only to ask whether the person on the line is that lead; never said to anyone who is not confirmed, never left on a voicemail. Whether the platform passes this is an open question; when empty the agent asks whether it is speaking with the person who enquired.

variables.name: lead_source
variables.description: Outbound calls: where the number came from, in the business's own words (for example a form or an event). Said only when a caller asks where the number came from and only when the field is not empty. When empty the agent never guesses a source. Whether the platform passes this is an open question.
